messages:
elsa: hey team, elsa here — first day. trying to run the infra pipeline from my fork, buildkite job fails pulling the runner image (403). any onboarding gotchas?

mike: welcome! common cause is GitHub App not installed on forks / repo. also check you joined the okta group redwood-ci for pipeline perms.

elsa: agent log:
```
Error: failed to pull image \"ghcr.io/redwood/ci-runner:latest\": access denied: 403
{"message":"You must have read access to the container registry."}
```

karen: do you see an invite to install the Redwood GitHub App? forks don't inherit org installs. if not, either install the app on the fork or we can add a temporary PAT with packages:read. ping me and I'll add you to redwood-ci group.

elsa: no invite in my email. i've accepted the org invite but not the app. karen, please add me to the group.

devops-bot: Access request created: CI-8012 assigned to infra-oncall. Status: pending.

karen: added you to redwood-ci. also pushed a small docs note to onboarding repo about forks + GHCR. try restarting after I send a temp token in chat.

karen: sent masked env var CI_GHCR_TOKEN to your buildkite pipeline vars.

elsa: restarted build — looks green now :tada: thanks everyone! I'll file a quick PR to clarify the onboarding steps for forks.

mike: great. welcome aboard!
